**Goerli Dencun Announcement** 📣 

The blobs are coming! Dencun will go live on Goerli at 6:32 UTC on January 17, 2024. See this post for client releases and other important information on the upgrade: https://blog.ethereum.org/2024/01/10/goerli-dencun-announcement
